legacy_root.title: Owner ruling that makes stop condition 13 satisfiable under PR-ONLY
legacy_root.question: Under the binding PR-ONLY release mode there is no canary channel, so what must succeed in place of program stop condition 13, 'release/canary succeeds' (spec 11390), which currently has no satisfiable referent and therefore makes the program unable to ever meet its own stopping rule?

recommendation.summary: Redefine condition 13 as a merged PR plus a clean-profile install, upgrade and rollback rehearsal evidenced by the REL-0004, REL-0005 and REL-0006 receipts.
recommendation.oq9_alignment: OQ-9 delegated default is a green CI install/upgrade/rollback rehearsal standing in for the canary. REL-0003 specialises that ruling onto catalog units REL-0004/REL-0005/REL-0006 whose output_path values are id-lookup checked. WAVE4-PLUGIN-LIFECYCLE-VERIFY.json is not a catalog work-unit id and is therefore not a named receipt.

legacy_root.strongest_tradeoff: The strongest tradeoff against marking condition 13 permanently N/A is that N/A deletes the observation the canary existed to provide: proof that install, upgrade, and rollback actually work. Under PR-ONLY the program never creates a canary channel, but it still merges pull requests; a merged PR plus the REL-0004/REL-0005/REL-0006 rehearsal receipts keep that proof. Permanent N/A would let the stopping rule go green without those receipts, which is how an unsatisfiable gate becomes a silent skip.
legacy_root.default_if_unanswered: If the owner does not answer, apply the recommendation: redefine condition 13 as a merged PR plus a clean-profile install, upgrade and rollback rehearsal evidenced by command-center/receipts/REL-0004.json, command-center/receipts/REL-0005.json and command-center/receipts/REL-0006.json. Do not mark 13 permanently N/A.

spec_quote_11390.note: _USER-PROMPTS.md is absent on this worktree. The verbatim text of spec line 11390 is taken from independent catalog citations that name that line.

answer.text: Apply the REL-0003 recommendation. Condition 13 is SATISFIABLE under PR-ONLY when a merged PR is accompanied by green REL-0004 (install), REL-0005 (upgrade) and REL-0006 (rollback) receipts. Marking 13 permanently N/A is rejected.
